title: Synthetic Media and the Fragility of Evidence
text:
Synthetic media can now produce convincing images and recordings of people saying things they never said. The technology has legitimate uses in film and accessibility, but it also threatens the shared evidence on which public debate depends. When any recording can be doubted, the burden shifts from proving falsehood to establishing authenticity.

Some observers fear a 'liar's dividend', in which genuine material is dismissed as fake simply because fabrication is possible. The remedy, they suggest, lies partly in provenance systems that record where a file came from and how it was edited. Such tools cannot guarantee truth, but they make deception more costly and verification more routine.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what can synthetic media produce?
options: Convincing images and recordings of people saying things they never said

questions.text: What does the second paragraph say some observers fear?
options: That genuine material will be dismissed as fake because fabrication is possible
That provenance systems will be too cheap
That films will lose their audiences

questions.text: What does the passage imply about the burden of proof?
options: It has shifted toward establishing that material is authentic
It now rests only with governments
It is no longer relevant to public debate

questions.text: Why might provenance systems be valuable even though they cannot guarantee truth?
options: They make deception more costly and verification more routine
They make recordings cheaper to produce

vocabulary.definition: the making of false material intended to pass as genuine
the record of where something came from and how it has been handled
the quality of being genuine and not a copy or forgery
the process of confirming that something is true or accurate

paragraph_translations: מדיה סינתטית יכולה כיום להפיק תמונות והקלטות משכנעות של אנשים שאומרים דברים שמעולם לא אמרו. לטכנולוגיה יש שימושים לגיטימיים בקולנוע ובנגישות, אך היא גם מאיימת על הראיות המשותפות שעליהן נשען הוויכוח הציבורי. כאשר כל הקלטה יכולה להיות מוטלת בספק, נטל ההוכחה עובר מהוכחת השקר לקביעת האותנטיות.

יש משקיפים החוששים מ'דיבידנד השקרן', שבו חומר אמיתי נפסל כמזויף רק משום שזיוף אפשרי. הפתרון, לדבריהם, טמון בחלקו במערכות מקור שמתעדות מאיפה הגיע הקובץ וכיצד נערך. כלים כאלה אינם יכולים להבטיח אמת, אך הם מייקרים את ההטעיה ומפכים את האימות לשגרה.
